items.html: And behold, when he has only six extremities, he has no aspect of life except that tenth part of the life he had, which reaches the Nukva. And then that life, which is only a tenth part alone, is divided, and it is divided into the six extremities and the Malchut within it. And this is the explanation of "Kista deChayuta," for it is the measure of the life of ZA when he is in the aspect of emanation with only six extremities. And in Sha'ar HaPesukim, Parashat Vayeshev, on the verse "And Joseph was brought down to Egypt," the matter of sleep, dream, and interpretation — what they are — is explained very well.
